lines.text: The Company had arrived to conduct business. Unfortunately for the local rulers, it had developed an increasingly generous interpretation of the word.

lines.text: Bombay: Tax recorded; 0 unrest added.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: “I had assumed the conquest was payment enough. Evidently, I misunderstood the terms.”
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: “The revenue has been requested. I am confident the gentlemen responsible for providing it will appreciate the distinction between a request and an obligation.”
lines.speaker: Edward Hale

history.title: Bombay · Tax 2 this turn
history.report:
Resolve the successful Tax’s £2 payment on the table.

Add 1 unrest to Bombay (now 1).

lines.text: The Company had expected gratitude, or at least obedience. The inhabitants, demonstrating their usual difficulty with administrative terminology, appeared to have confused both with resentment.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: “Again? I had assumed the Company's appetite might occasionally be satisfied. Evidently, I have misunderstood its constitution.”
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: “A most encouraging result. The natives have demonstrated a remarkable willingness to contribute to their own improvement.”
lines.speaker: Edward Hale

history.title: Bombay · Unsuccessful Administer
history.report: Add 1 unrest to Bombay (now 2).

lines.text: The initiative had failed. Responsibility was promptly referred to another department.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: “A discontented population is a dangerous thing. Particularly when those responsible for its discontent believe themselves universally adored.”
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: “An unfortunate outcome. I shall recommend a committee to determine which committee ought to have prevented it.”
lines.speaker: Edward Hale

history.report:

lines.text: Commercial activity in Bombay had suffered another interruption. The Company's merchants were expected to take the development personally.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: “The Company appears astonished that trade requires the cooperation of those with whom it wishes to trade.”
lines.speaker: Madhav of Bombay

lines.text: “A most unfortunate disruption. Commerce cannot be expected to flourish when everyone insists upon having opinions about it.”
lines.speaker: Edward Hale

lines.text: The Company intervention in Bombay cleared its unrest and restored commercial access.

lines.text: “I understand the Company has brought soldiers to encourage trade. Its understanding of voluntary commerce continues to fascinate me.”

history.title: Events in India · phase begins
history.report:
Storm die: All three seas. Resolve 1 India event after storms.

In West Indian Ocean, South Indian Ocean, East Indian Ocean, roll one physical die per ship except Company ships and Extra ships.

Ships assigned to the Superintendent of Trade in China count as being in the East Indian Ocean for storms.

1–2: no effect.

3–4: fatigue the ship. If it was already fatigued, it sinks.

5–6: the ship sinks.

Return sunk ships to their shipyards, flipped to their non-fatigued side. Resolve all ship rolls before drawing the first India event.

lines.text: Events in India · phase begins.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

history.title: Events in India · storms resolved
history.report: All affected ships have been checked on the table. The next India event may now be drawn from the digital stack.

history.title: India stack · tile revealed
history.report: Reveal Leader (+3). Its back was Punjab. Resolve this event before drawing another.

history.title: India event · Leader
history.report:
Hyderabad: set tower to 2 levels.

India event 1 of 1 resolved. All required events are complete; finish the phase when ready.

lines.text: India event · Leader. Hyderabad: 2 tower levels, 0 unrest; 1 disrupted commercial opportunities.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

history.title: Events in India · phase complete
history.report: All India events are resolved. If the Company has failed, choose End game and proceed to Final Scoring. Otherwise continue to Parliament Meets.

history.title: Parliament complete
history.report:
Parliament is finished. No additional India changes are required.

Complete prize upkeep on the table, skip refresh and proceed to Final Scoring.

history.title: Game ended · Final turn completed
history.report:
The chronicle closes on turn 5: Final turn completed.

Complete final prize upkeep if not already done, skip refresh, and resolve Final Scoring on the physical board.

After Final Scoring, the player with the most victory points wins. Break ties by most window icons, then clockwise order starting with the Prime Minister.

Final Company territory: Bombay. Company regions lost this turn: 0.

The final map, event stack and campaign record are preserved. Gameplay is closed; Undo reopens the game. Export a JSON backup from Saved games to keep the chronicle.
